Is It a Name?

In 2026, parents are asking if anything can be a name. Here are the most searched "is [word] a name?" queries.

❓

"is billiam a name"

This was one of the hottest name-related searches of 2026. Parents are increasingly open to invented and unconventional names.

Our take: While not traditionally recognized, names like Billiam reflect the growing trend of linguistic creativity in baby naming. If it has a sound you love and a meaning you assign to it, it can absolutely be a name!

❓

"is iso a name"

This was one of the hottest name-related searches of 2026. Parents are increasingly open to invented and unconventional names.

Our take: While not traditionally recognized, names like Iso reflect the growing trend of linguistic creativity in baby naming. If it has a sound you love and a meaning you assign to it, it can absolutely be a name!

What Makes a Name?

A name is simply a word used to identify a person. While traditional names have historical and etymological roots, modern naming is increasingly about personal meaning and sound.

📜

Traditional

Names with centuries of documented use and etymological roots.

🌿

Nature

Words from nature repurposed as names: River, Bear, Willow.

✨

Invented

Newly created words with personal or aesthetic significance.
